lead.headline: Anthropic prices its IPO at $83 a share and starts trading on Nasdaq today, the biggest IPO on record
lead.summary: The offering is 980 million shares, about 956 million sold by Anthropic itself and the rest by existing holders. AP says the price values the Claude maker at about $1.5 trillion and passes SpaceX as the largest IPO ever; Renaissance Capital puts gross proceeds at about $81.3 billion. Shares are expected to trade under the ticker ANT. The pricing came in above expectations despite bubble worries and the turmoil after Nvidia's CEO change.

number_of_day.label: Data centres in Finland today, and the total if the roughly 150 planned ones get built. President Stubb used the figures in Slush's opening talk to argue Finland can become an AI-infrastructure superpower.

news.headline: Google's Gemini 4 Neon: a fast frontier model at $3 / $15 with a 1M context
news.summary: Google says Neon is #3 overall on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index (61, at xhigh thinking) and #2 on the Vals Index, with its lowest fabrication rate yet in internal Antigravity testing. Cached input is $0.15 per million tokens. It is rolling out in the Gemini API, Antigravity and the Gemini app, and it's already in Cursor and GitHub Copilot.

news.headline: Mistral Vibe goes desktop, with local and cloud agents on Git worktrees
news.summary: The macOS and Windows app (Linux 'coming soon') combines Vibe CLI's local runs with cloud sandbox sessions, so parallel agents can work on separate branches of the same repo. It works with VS Code, JetBrains and Zed via ACP, plus MCP. European developers get three free months of Pro ($14.99/mo) with the code LECHONK, and Mistral had to add more codes after day one.

news.headline: OpenAI shows how its models redesigned parts of its Jalapeño chip, and now AMD GPU blocks
news.summary: One multiplier redesign used about 15% less cell area and cut latency from two clock cycles to one; an adder lost about 15% of its area with the same latency. OpenAI is now applying the approach to AMD hardware and working with Synopsys to build frontier models into the chip-design (EDA) tools engineers already use.

news.headline: Slush opens in Helsinki, and Stubb pitches Finland as an AI-infrastructure superpower
news.summary: 12,000 people at a sold-out Slush on 18–19 Nov. In the opening talk the president pointed to clean energy (96% of supply, he said), Nokia's networks, and IQM, Bluefors, Iceye and Reorbit, and suggested that Google's planned €13B investment in Finland could end up much larger.

x_posts.name: Guillermo Rauch
x_posts.text:
I’m being pitched a new inference neocloud company on average every two days. No exaggeration. I take every entrepreneur seriously and I look deeply into each.

But it’s hard to fathom this being sustainable. At the same time, AI Gateway token demand on Vercel has been ~40% MoM
x_posts.why: Bubble or real demand? Vercel's CEO sees both: a flood of neocloud pitches and 40% monthly token growth.

quick_hit.label: Fine print
quick_hit.text: Citi updated its terms so customers are responsible for what third-party AI agents with access to their accounts do, even when something goes wrong. Other banks are taking similar positions.
